skill.name: skill-management
skill.description: Manage agent skills — list, preview, create, edit, and delete skill files.
skill.skill_management_intent_routing:
1. LIST (list, view, inspect, show): - Call `list_skills(module)` only. - Valid modules: `finance`, `obsidian`, `configuration`. - Never chain create, edit, or delete tools after a list intent. - Return the listed skill names and descriptions to the user.
2. PREVIEW (preview, read, open, inspect content, show skill): - Call `preview_skill(module, name)` only. - Return the full skill file content to the user. - Never execute the skill steps or call downstream agent tools after a preview.
3. CREATE (create, add, new): - Default: follow `skill-bootstrap` (from `` or `read_skill("skill-bootstrap")`). - Only call `create_skill(module, name, description, content)` directly when the user already provides all four: module, name, description, and full body content. - Never ask the user for missing description or content manually; bootstrap gathers context and drafts them. - Use a concise kebab-case name and a clear one-line description. - The tool sets the root `` attribute from the module argument.
4. EDIT (edit, update, change, rewrite): - Call `preview_skill(module, name)` first. - Then call `edit_skill(module, name, description, content)` with the full replacement description and body.
5. DELETE (remove, delete): - Require explicit user intent before deleting. - Call `delete_skill(module, name)`.
